verdict.rationale: Keycloak provides core OAuth2/OIDC primitives that could underpin an agent token-vault pattern—identity brokering to link/store external IdP accounts, client-credentials and device-authorization grants for delegated/service access, and token introspection/revocation for short-lived token management—but no evidence describes an actual token-exchange (RFC 8693) flow, explicit third-party API token vault, or user-consent UX built for AI agent tool calls. missing for 10: explicit token-exchange/on-behalf-of delegation flow, documented token vault for third-party API credentials, agent-specific consent UI or scoping, independent confirmation of this pattern in production use.
